question: Which of the following is/are most essential for growth and development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Protein**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Proteins** are crucial for the growth and development of the human body.
 
• They are made up of amino acids, which are the building blocks of tissues, muscles, and organs.
 
• Proteins play a key role in repairing damaged tissues and making enzymes, hormones, and other body chemicals.
 
• They are also essential for the immune system to function properly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Proteins are found in various food sources such as meat, dairy products, nuts, and legumes.
 
• It is recommended that adults consume about 50 grams of protein per day, though this amount can vary based on individual health needs and activity levels.
 
• Protein deficiency can lead to various health issues including muscle wasting, weakened immune system, and growth retardation in children.
